verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a public API for entity search or filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web forms, mail and phone channels, and an online filing site. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and the filing host reset the connection, so there is no documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
